descriptions.base_description: A pen-sized radiation detector, yellow plastic cracked from use. The clip still works. The display flickers when you tap it.
descriptions.current_state: Functional but worn. The display has a dead pixel in the corner. The battery compartment is taped shut.
descriptions.visual_indicators: Yellow plastic, cracked lens, taped battery compartment. The clip leaves a mark on your pocket.
descriptions.functional_description: Clicks faster near radiation. The display shows millisieverts. You've learned to read it like a heartbeat.
descriptions.sensory_details: Light in your pocket. The click is soft — you have to be quiet to hear it. The plastic is warm from your body heat.
descriptions.emotional_weight: Your lifeline. The only thing between you and invisible death. You check it like others check their watches.
descriptions.hazards: If the battery dies, you're blind to radiation. If the display cracks, you're guessing. If you lose it, you're dead.
descriptions.dependencies: Needs a watch battery. Needs to be calibrated. Needs to be on your person at all times.
descriptions.contamination_status: Clean. You wipe it down after every use.
descriptions.preservation_state: Good. You treat it better than your food.
descriptions.makeshift_utility: Can be used as a light source in emergencies. The clip can hold papers. The plastic case is surprisingly sturdy.
descriptions.alternatives: A geiger counter is better but heavier. A film badge is lighter but doesn't give real-time readings. Your body is the worst alternative.
descriptions.system_integration: Tracks radiation exposure. Essential for survival in contaminated zones.

descriptions.base_description: A handheld radiation detector, olive drab, military surplus. The antenna is bent. The speaker crackles.
descriptions.current_state: Functional. The speaker is scratchy. The dial is stiff. The battery lasts about 40 hours.
descriptions.visual_indicators: Olive drab paint, scratched to metal. Bent antenna. Worn dial markings.
descriptions.functional_description: More sensitive than a dosimeter. Picks up radiation from further away. The speaker gives you audio warning.
descriptions.sensory_details: Heavy in your hand. The speaker crackles like a dying radio. The dial clicks when you turn it.
descriptions.emotional_weight: Military equipment. Someone carried this before you. They probably died with it in their hand.
descriptions.hazards: The speaker can give you away. The antenna can break. The battery is proprietary — when it's gone, it's gone.
descriptions.dependencies: Needs a 9V battery. Needs the antenna intact. Needs to be held at the right angle.
descriptions.contamination_status: Clean. You don't bring it near hot zones if you can help it.
descriptions.preservation_state: Fair. The paint is gone but the electronics work.
descriptions.makeshift_utility: The antenna can be used as a wire. The case is waterproof. The speaker can be repurposed.
descriptions.alternatives: A dosimeter is lighter but less sensitive. A survey meter is more sensitive but heavier.
descriptions.system_integration: Advanced radiation detection. Essential for mapping contaminated areas.

descriptions.base_description: A blister pack of potassium iodide tablets. White, chalky, bitter. The foil is peeling at the edges.
descriptions.current_state: Intact but aging. The foil is oxidizing. The tablets are still white. The expiration date is rubbed off.
descriptions.visual_indicators: White tablets in silver foil. The foil is dark at the edges. The pack is half-empty.
descriptions.functional_description: Blocks radioactive iodine from accumulating in your thyroid. Take before or shortly after exposure.
descriptions.sensory_details: Chalky on your tongue. Bitter going down. The foil crinkles loudly in the quiet.
descriptions.emotional_weight: Nuclear medicine. The kind of thing you never thought you'd need. The kind of thing you're grateful for.
descriptions.hazards: Can cause nausea, vomiting, allergic reactions. Overuse can damage your thyroid. Underuse can let radiation in.
descriptions.dependencies: Needs to be taken with water. Needs to be taken at the right time. Needs to be stored dry.
descriptions.contamination_status: Clean. Sealed until you break the foil.
descriptions.preservation_state: Good. The foil protects the tablets. The tablets protect your thyroid.
descriptions.makeshift_utility: None. They do one thing. They do it well.
descriptions.alternatives: Anti-rad medication is broader spectrum. Nothing else protects your thyroid specifically.
descriptions.system_integration: Provides temporary radiation resistance. Essential for short-term exposure events.

descriptions.base_description: A syringe of Prussian blue or DTPA. The liquid is clear, the needle is capped. The label is in medical shorthand.
descriptions.current_state: Intact. The syringe is sealed. The liquid is clear. The needle is sharp.
descriptions.visual_indicators: Clear liquid in a glass syringe. Capped needle. Medical label with dosage.
descriptions.functional_description: Chelation therapy. Binds to radioactive particles and helps your body expel them. Reduces your radiation dose.
descriptions.sensory_details: The needle stings. The liquid is cold going in. Your arm aches for hours after.
descriptions.emotional_weight: Hospital medicine. The kind of thing that used to come with a nurse and a clean room. Now it comes with a prayer.
descriptions.hazards: Can cause allergic reactions. Can interact with other medications. Can be contaminated if the seal is broken.
descriptions.dependencies: Needs to be injected. Needs a clean needle site. Needs to be stored cold if possible.
descriptions.preservation_state: Good. The glass protects the liquid. The cap protects the needle.
descriptions.makeshift_utility: None. Medical use only.
descriptions.alternatives: Iodine pills protect the thyroid. Anti-rad protects everything else. Together they're your best defense.
descriptions.system_integration: Reduces accumulated radiation. Essential for long-term survival in contaminated areas.

descriptions.base_description: A military gas mask, olive drab rubber, cracked visor. The filter is attached. The straps are frayed.
descriptions.current_state: Functional but degraded. The rubber is cracking. The filter is half-spent. The visor is scratched.
descriptions.visual_indicators: Olive drab rubber, cracked at the seams. Scratched visor. Frayed straps. Attached filter.
descriptions.functional_description: Filters airborne particles, chemical agents, and some biological threats. Essential in contaminated air.
descriptions.sensory_details: Rubber smell, stale breath, your own heartbeat amplified. The visor fogs with your breathing.
descriptions.emotional_weight: Military equipment. The face of survival. You look like everyone else in it — anonymous, afraid.
descriptions.hazards: Can restrict breathing. Can cause panic. Can fail if the seal is broken. The filter has a limited lifespan.
descriptions.dependencies: Needs a working filter. Needs a good seal against your face. Needs to be the right size.
descriptions.contamination_status: Exterior contaminated after use. Interior clean if the seal holds.
descriptions.preservation_state: Fair. The rubber is aging. The filter is degrading. The visor is scratched.
descriptions.makeshift_utility: The filter can be repurposed. The rubber can be used as sealant. The visor can be used as a shield.
descriptions.alternatives: A cloth mask is worse. A respirator is better but heavier. Holding your breath is temporary.
descriptions.system_integration: Provides radiation and contamination protection. Essential for entering contaminated zones.

descriptions.base_description: A full-body hazmat suit, yellow plastic, sealed seams. The visor is fogged. The gloves are thick.
descriptions.current_state: Functional but degrading. The plastic is stiffening. The seams are weakening. The visor is scratched.
descriptions.visual_indicators: Yellow plastic, sealed seams, fogged visor, thick gloves. You look like a spaceman in it.
descriptions.functional_description: Full-body protection against radiation, chemical, and biological contamination. Sealed environment.
descriptions.sensory_details: Plastic rustle with every step. Your breath is loud inside. Sweat runs down your back. The gloves make everything clumsy.
descriptions.emotional_weight: Isolation gear. You're sealed inside yourself. No skin, no touch, no smell except your own.
descriptions.hazards: Can cause overheating. Can restrict movement. Can fail at the seams. Can be punctured by sharp objects.
descriptions.dependencies: Needs to be sealed. Needs to be the right size. Needs to be paired with a gas mask.
descriptions.contamination_status: Exterior heavily contaminated after use. Interior clean if the seal holds.
descriptions.preservation_state: Fair. The plastic is aging. The seams are weakening. The visor is scratched.
descriptions.makeshift_utility: The plastic can be used as sheeting. The gloves can be used for handling hot objects. The visor can be used as a shield.
descriptions.alternatives: A gas mask alone is partial protection. Regular clothing is no protection. Nothing is perfect.
descriptions.system_integration: Maximum radiation and contamination protection. Essential for high-risk operations.

descriptions.base_description: A portable water filter, plastic housing, ceramic element. The hose is cracked. The pump handle is worn smooth.
descriptions.current_state: Functional but degraded. The ceramic element is clogging. The hose is cracked. The pump is stiff.
descriptions.visual_indicators: White plastic housing, ceramic element visible through clear section. Cracked hose. Worn pump handle.
descriptions.functional_description: Filters water through a ceramic element. Removes sediment, bacteria, and some chemicals. Makes dirty water drinkable.
descriptions.sensory_details: The pump squeaks. The water trickles through. The ceramic is smooth when you clean it. The hose drips at the crack.
descriptions.emotional_weight: Clean water. The difference between life and death. You guard it like gold.
descriptions.hazards: Can clog if not cleaned. Can crack if dropped. Can freeze and break in cold. The hose can split.
descriptions.dependencies: Needs water to filter. Needs to be cleaned regularly. Needs the ceramic element intact.
descriptions.contamination_status: Exterior dirty. Interior clean if maintained.
descriptions.preservation_state: Fair. The plastic is scratched. The ceramic is wearing. The hose needs replacing.
descriptions.makeshift_utility: The ceramic can be used as a grinding stone. The plastic can be used as a container. The hose can be used as tubing.
descriptions.alternatives: Boiling kills germs but doesn't remove sediment. Chemical treatment kills germs but adds taste. Nothing replaces filtration.
descriptions.system_integration: Converts contaminated water to clean water. Essential for long-term survival.

descriptions.base_description: A shelter air filter, HEPA-rated, metal housing. The fan is loud. The filter is gray with use.
descriptions.current_state: Functional but degraded. The filter is loading. The fan is loud. The housing is dented.
descriptions.visual_indicators: Metal housing, dented. Gray HEPA filter visible through grill. Loud fan.
descriptions.functional_description: Filters airborne particles from shelter air. Reduces radiation dust, ash, and biological contaminants.
descriptions.sensory_details: The fan hums constantly. The air smells cleaner after it runs. The filter is warm to the touch.
descriptions.emotional_weight: Clean air. The difference between breathing and suffocating. You run it like a prayer.
descriptions.hazards: Can overheat. Can clog. Can fail if the power dies. The filter has a limited lifespan.
descriptions.dependencies: Needs power. Needs a replacement filter. Needs to be run regularly.
descriptions.contamination_status: Exterior dirty. Interior clean if the filter holds.
descriptions.preservation_state: Fair. The housing is dented. The filter is loading. The fan is loud.
descriptions.makeshift_utility: The filter can be used as a pre-filter for water. The fan can be repurposed. The housing can be used as a container.
descriptions.alternatives: Opening a window lets in contaminated air. A cloth mask is partial protection. Nothing replaces HEPA filtration.
descriptions.system_integration: Maintains shelter air quality. Essential for long-term shelter survival.

descriptions.base_description: A bottle of clear water. The plastic is scratched. The cap is tight. The water is clean.
descriptions.current_state: Clean and drinkable. The bottle is intact. The water is clear.
descriptions.visual_indicators: Clear water in a scratched plastic bottle. Tight cap. No sediment.
descriptions.functional_description: Drinkable water. Restores thirst. Essential for survival.
descriptions.sensory_details: Cool on your tongue. Clean taste. The plastic crinkles when you squeeze the bottle.
descriptions.emotional_weight: Life. The most valuable thing you carry. You ration it like blood.
descriptions.hazards: Can be contaminated if the bottle is opened in a dirty environment. Can freeze in cold. Can evaporate in heat.
descriptions.dependencies: Needs a container. Needs to be sealed. Needs to be kept clean.
descriptions.preservation_state: Good. The plastic protects the water. The cap seals the bottle.
descriptions.makeshift_utility: None. It's water. You drink it.
descriptions.alternatives: Irradiated water is dangerous. Dirty water is worse. Rain water is variable. Nothing replaces clean water.
descriptions.system_integration: Restores thirst. Essential for survival. Can be used in crafting and medical applications.

descriptions.base_description: A bottle of yellowish water. The plastic is stained. The cap is loose. The water glows faintly.
descriptions.current_state: Contaminated. The water is yellowish. The plastic is stained. The cap doesn't seal properly.
descriptions.visual_indicators: Yellowish water in a stained plastic bottle. Loose cap. Faint glow in dark conditions.
descriptions.functional_description: Contaminated water. Can be purified with a filter or boiling. Drinking it raw causes radiation exposure.
descriptions.sensory_details: Warm on your tongue. Metallic taste. The plastic smells like chemicals. Your throat burns after drinking.
descriptions.emotional_weight: Poison. The kind of thing you drink when you're desperate. The kind of thing you regret.
descriptions.hazards: Causes radiation exposure. Can cause nausea, vomiting, diarrhea. Can be fatal in large quantities.
descriptions.dependencies: Needs purification before drinking. Needs a filter or fire. Needs time.
descriptions.contamination_status: Heavily contaminated. Do not drink raw.
descriptions.preservation_state: Poor. The plastic is degrading. The water is contaminated.
descriptions.makeshift_utility: Can be purified. Can be used for cleaning (not drinking). Can be used for cooling.
descriptions.alternatives: Clean water is better. Rain water is variable. Nothing replaces purification.
descriptions.system_integration: Causes radiation exposure if consumed raw. Can be purified to clean water.

descriptions.base_description: A dented can, label missing, rust at the seams. The contents are unknown. The can is intact.
descriptions.current_state: Intact but unknown. The can is dented. The label is gone. The rust is spreading.
descriptions.visual_indicators: Dented metal can, no label, rust at seams. Unknown contents.
descriptions.functional_description: Preserved food. Restores hunger. The contents are unknown until opened.
descriptions.sensory_details: Heavy in your hand. The metal is cold. The can sloshes when you shake it. The opener scrapes.
descriptions.emotional_weight: Mystery dinner. You eat what you find. You don't ask what it was.
descriptions.hazards: Can be spoiled. Can be contaminated. Can be botulism. Can be something you don't want to eat.
descriptions.dependencies: Needs a can opener. Needs to be inspected after opening. Needs to be cooked if possible.
descriptions.contamination_status: Unknown until opened. Exterior contaminated if found in a dirty area.
descriptions.preservation_state: Fair. The can protects the food. The rust is a concern.
descriptions.makeshift_utility: The can can be used as a container. The lid can be used as a cutting tool. The metal can be used for crafting.
descriptions.alternatives: Fresh food is better but rare. Dried food is lighter. Nothing replaces calories.
descriptions.system_integration: Restores hunger. Contents unknown until opened. Can be contaminated.

descriptions.base_description: A strip of clean cloth, rolled tight, tied with string. The fabric is white, slightly yellowed with age.
descriptions.current_state: Clean and intact. The cloth is soft. The string is tight. The roll is compact.
descriptions.visual_indicators: White cloth roll, slightly yellowed. Tied with string. Compact.
descriptions.functional_description: Basic wound care. Stops bleeding. Protects wounds from contamination. Can be used with antiseptic.
descriptions.sensory_details: Soft against your skin. The string scratches. The cloth smells like nothing — which means it's clean.
descriptions.emotional_weight: First aid. The difference between bleeding out and living. You carry more than you think you need.
descriptions.hazards: Can become contaminated if dropped. Can cause infection if the wound isn't cleaned first. Can restrict blood flow if too tight.
descriptions.dependencies: Needs a wound to treat. Needs to be clean. Needs to be changed regularly.
descriptions.contamination_status: Clean until used. Contaminated after use.
descriptions.preservation_state: Good. The cloth is clean. The string is tight.
descriptions.makeshift_utility: Can be used as a rope. Can be used as a filter. Can be used as a bandana.
descriptions.alternatives: A medical kit is better. Duct tape is worse. Nothing replaces clean cloth.
descriptions.system_integration: Restores health. Essential for wound care. Can be used in crafting.

descriptions.base_description: A red cross kit, metal box, white cross on red background. The latch is stiff. The contents are organized.
descriptions.current_state: Intact and organized. The metal is dented. The latch is stiff. The contents are complete.
descriptions.visual_indicators: Red metal box, white cross, dented, stiff latch.
descriptions.functional_description: Complete medical supplies. Bandages, antiseptic, painkillers, tools. Treats serious injuries.
descriptions.sensory_details: Metal clank when you open it. The antiseptic smells sharp. The bandages are soft. The tools are cold.
descriptions.emotional_weight: Hospital in a box. The kind of thing that saves lives. The kind of thing you don't share.
descriptions.hazards: Can be contaminated if opened in a dirty environment. Can be stolen. Can be used up.
descriptions.dependencies: Needs to be kept clean. Needs to be restocked. Needs to be accessible.
descriptions.contamination_status: Clean until opened. Interior clean if maintained.
descriptions.preservation_state: Good. The metal protects the contents. The latch keeps it sealed.
descriptions.makeshift_utility: The box can be used as a container. The tools can be used for other purposes. The bandages can be used for other things.
descriptions.alternatives: Individual supplies are lighter but less complete. Nothing replaces a full kit.
descriptions.system_integration: Major health restoration. Essential for serious injuries. Can be used in medical procedures.

descriptions.base_description: A jerry can of gasoline, red plastic, heavy. The cap is tight. The fuel sloshes when you move it.
descriptions.current_state: Full and intact. The plastic is scratched. The cap is tight. The fuel is stable.
descriptions.visual_indicators: Red plastic jerry can, scratched, heavy, tight cap.
descriptions.functional_description: Fuel for vehicles, generators, stoves. Essential for power and transportation.
descriptions.sensory_details: Heavy in your hand. The fuel sloshes. The plastic smells like gasoline. The cap is hard to open.
descriptions.emotional_weight: Power. The kind of thing that makes things work. The kind of thing people kill for.
descriptions.hazards: Flammable. Explosive. Toxic fumes. Can be contaminated with water. Can degrade over time.
descriptions.dependencies: Needs a container. Needs to be sealed. Needs to be stored safely.
descriptions.contamination_status: Clean if the container is sealed. Contaminated if the container is open.
descriptions.preservation_state: Good. The plastic protects the fuel. The cap seals the container.
descriptions.makeshift_utility: Can be used as a fire starter. Can be used as a solvent. Can be used as a weapon.
descriptions.alternatives: Diesel is different. Alcohol is worse. Nothing replaces gasoline for engines.
descriptions.system_integration: Powers vehicles and generators. Essential for transportation and electricity.

descriptions.base_description: A 9-volt battery, rectangular, two terminals on top. The label is faded. The metal is corroded.
descriptions.current_state: Partially charged. The label is faded. The terminals are corroded. The metal is oxidizing.
descriptions.visual_indicators: Rectangular battery, faded label, corroded terminals, oxidized metal.
descriptions.functional_description: Powers small electronics. Radios, flashlights, dosimeters. Essential for communication and detection.
descriptions.sensory_details: Light in your hand. The terminals taste like metal if you touch them to your tongue. The corroded ones sting.
descriptions.emotional_weight: Power. The kind of thing that makes other things work. The kind of thing you hoard.
descriptions.hazards: Can leak acid. Can explode if shorted. Can corrode devices if left in too long.
descriptions.dependencies: Needs a device to power. Needs to be the right size. Needs to be charged or fresh.
descriptions.contamination_status: Clean. The metal is corroded but the battery is sealed.
descriptions.preservation_state: Fair. The label is fading. The terminals are corroding.
descriptions.makeshift_utility: Can be used as a fire starter (shorted). Can be used as a weight. Can be used as a trade item.
descriptions.alternatives: Solar panels are renewable but slow. Hand cranks are manual. Nothing replaces batteries for portability.
descriptions.system_integration: Powers essential devices. Limited charge. Can be recharged in some systems.

descriptions.base_description: A bolt of cloth, gray, frayed at the edges. The fabric is thin. The weave is loose.
descriptions.current_state: Worn but usable. The fabric is thin. The edges are frayed. The color is fading.
descriptions.visual_indicators: Gray cloth, frayed edges, thin fabric, loose weave.
descriptions.functional_description: Crafting material. Can be used for bandages, clothing, filters, bags. Essential for many recipes.
descriptions.sensory_details: Soft against your skin. The fabric breathes. The edges scratch. The color is dull.
descriptions.emotional_weight: Material. The kind of thing that becomes other things. The kind of thing you never have enough of.
descriptions.hazards: Can be contaminated. Can be torn. Can be burned. Can be eaten by insects.
descriptions.dependencies: Needs to be clean for medical use. Needs to be cut for crafting. Needs to be strong for structural use.
descriptions.contamination_status: Variable. Depends on where it was found.
descriptions.preservation_state: Fair. The fabric is wearing. The edges are fraying.
descriptions.makeshift_utility: Can be used as a bandage. Can be used as a filter. Can be used as a rope. Can be used as a bag.
descriptions.alternatives: Leather is stronger. Plastic is waterproof. Nothing replaces cloth for flexibility.
descriptions.system_integration: Crafting material. Essential for many recipes. Can be used in medical applications.

descriptions.base_description: A pile of metal scraps, mixed metals, rusted, bent. The edges are sharp. The weight is significant.
descriptions.current_state: Rusted and bent. The metals are mixed. The edges are sharp. The weight is heavy.
descriptions.visual_indicators: Mixed metal scraps, rusted, bent, sharp edges, heavy.
descriptions.functional_description: Crafting material. Can be used for tools, weapons, armor, construction. Essential for many recipes.
descriptions.sensory_details: Heavy in your hands. The edges cut. The rust stains your skin. The metal is cold.
descriptions.emotional_weight: Raw material. The kind of thing that becomes other things. The kind of thing you collect.
descriptions.hazards: Can cut you. Can be contaminated. Can be heavy. Can be sharp.
descriptions.dependencies: Needs to be cleaned for some uses. Needs to be shaped for crafting. Needs to be welded for construction.
descriptions.contamination_status: Variable. Usually contaminated with rust and dirt.
descriptions.preservation_state: Poor. The metal is rusting. The edges are sharp.
descriptions.makeshift_utility: Can be used as a weapon. Can be used as a tool. Can be used as a weight. Can be used as a trade item.
descriptions.alternatives: Wood is lighter. Plastic is softer. Nothing replaces metal for strength.
descriptions.system_integration: Crafting material. Essential for tools, weapons, and construction.

descriptions.base_description: A box of mechanical parts, gears, springs, screws, bolts. The metal is oiled. The parts are sorted.
descriptions.current_state: Organized and oiled. The parts are sorted. The metal is protected. The box is intact.
descriptions.visual_indicators: Metal box, sorted parts, oiled gears, springs, screws, bolts.
descriptions.functional_description: Crafting material for mechanical devices. Engines, pumps, generators, tools. Essential for advanced crafting.
descriptions.sensory_details: Metal clink when you move the box. The oil smells like machines. The parts are cold and smooth.
descriptions.emotional_weight: Engineering. The kind of thing that makes complex things work. The kind of thing you protect.
descriptions.hazards: Can be contaminated with oil. Can be sharp. Can be heavy. Can be lost easily.
descriptions.dependencies: Needs to be kept oiled. Needs to be kept organized. Needs to be kept dry.
descriptions.contamination_status: Clean if oiled. Contaminated if exposed to dirt.
descriptions.preservation_state: Good. The oil protects the metal. The box protects the parts.
descriptions.makeshift_utility: Can be used as trade items. Can be used as weights. Can be used as tools.
descriptions.alternatives: Electronic scrap is different. Chemicals are different. Nothing replaces mechanical parts for mechanical devices.
descriptions.system_integration: Crafting material for mechanical devices. Essential for advanced crafting.

descriptions.base_description: A box of electronic components, circuit boards, wires, chips, capacitors. The parts are delicate. The box is padded.
descriptions.current_state: Organized and padded. The parts are delicate. The box is intact. The components are sorted.
descriptions.visual_indicators: Padded box, circuit boards, wires, chips, capacitors, delicate components.
descriptions.functional_description: Crafting material for electronic devices. Radios, computers, sensors, communication equipment. Essential for advanced crafting.
descriptions.sensory_details: Light in your hands. The components are small and delicate. The wires are flexible. The circuit boards are smooth.
descriptions.emotional_weight: Technology. The kind of thing that makes modern things work. The kind of thing you protect.
descriptions.hazards: Can be damaged by water. Can be damaged by impact. Can be contaminated with lead solder. Can be sharp.
descriptions.dependencies: Needs to be kept dry. Needs to be kept padded. Needs to be kept organized.
descriptions.contamination_status: Clean if stored properly. Contaminated if exposed to water or dirt.
descriptions.preservation_state: Good. The padding protects the components. The box protects the padding.
descriptions.makeshift_utility: Can be used as trade items. Can be used as weights. Can be used as tools.
descriptions.alternatives: Mechanical parts are different. Chemicals are different. Nothing replaces electronic scrap for electronics.
descriptions.system_integration: Crafting material for electronic devices. Essential for advanced crafting.

descriptions.base_description: A box of chemical compounds, labeled bottles, powders, liquids. The labels are faded. The bottles are sealed.
descriptions.current_state: Organized and sealed. The labels are fading. The bottles are intact. The compounds are stable.
descriptions.visual_indicators: Labeled bottles, powders, liquids, faded labels, sealed containers.
descriptions.functional_description: Crafting material for chemical applications. Medicine, explosives, cleaning agents, fuel. Essential for advanced crafting.
descriptions.sensory_details: The bottles clink when you move the box. The chemicals smell sharp or sweet or acrid. The powders are fine.
descriptions.emotional_weight: Chemistry. The kind of thing that makes dangerous things work. The kind of thing you handle carefully.
descriptions.hazards: Can be toxic. Can be corrosive. Can be explosive. Can be flammable. Can be reactive.
descriptions.dependencies: Needs to be kept sealed. Needs to be kept cool. Needs to be kept away from other chemicals.
descriptions.contamination_status: Clean if sealed. Contaminated if spilled.
descriptions.preservation_state: Fair. The labels are fading. The bottles are sealing.
descriptions.makeshift_utility: Can be used as trade items. Can be used as weapons. Can be used as tools.
descriptions.alternatives: Mechanical parts are different. Electronic scrap is different. Nothing replaces chemicals for chemical applications.
descriptions.system_integration: Crafting material for chemical applications. Essential for medicine and advanced crafting.

descriptions.base_description: A handheld radio, black plastic, antenna, speaker, dial. The battery is low. The static is constant.
descriptions.current_state: Functional but degraded. The battery is low. The speaker is scratchy. The antenna is bent.
descriptions.visual_indicators: Black plastic, bent antenna, scratchy speaker, worn dial, low battery indicator.
descriptions.functional_description: Communication device. Can receive and transmit on various frequencies. Essential for coordination.
descriptions.sensory_details: Static crackle. The speaker is tinny. The plastic is warm from use. The dial clicks when you turn it.
descriptions.emotional_weight: Connection. The kind of thing that links you to others. The kind of thing that gives you hope.
descriptions.hazards: Can give away your position. Can be overheard. Can fail if the battery dies. Can be jammed.
descriptions.dependencies: Needs a battery. Needs an antenna. Needs a clear frequency. Needs someone to talk to.
descriptions.preservation_state: Fair. The battery is degrading. The speaker is wearing. The antenna is bent.
descriptions.makeshift_utility: The antenna can be used as a wire. The speaker can be repurposed. The plastic can be used as a case.
descriptions.alternatives: Signal mirrors are visual. Whistles are short range. Nothing replaces radio for long-range communication.
descriptions.system_integration: Communication device. Essential for coordination. Can receive broadcasts.

descriptions.base_description: A single-shot rifle made from pipe and scrap. The stock is wrapped in tape. The barrel is rough. It fires once, then needs reloading.
descriptions.current_state: Functional but crude. The barrel is rough. The trigger is stiff. The stock is taped.
descriptions.visual_indicators: Pipe barrel, taped stock, rough trigger, crude sights. Looks like it was made in a garage.
descriptions.functional_description: Single-shot improvised rifle. Fires one round, then reloads. Accurate at short range. Dangerous at any range.
descriptions.sensory_details: Heavy in your hands. The pipe is cold. The tape is sticky. The trigger clicks loudly.
descriptions.emotional_weight: Desperation. The kind of thing you make when you can't find a real weapon. The kind of thing that works.
descriptions.hazards: Can explode if the barrel is weak. Can jam if the action is rough. Can miss if the sights are off.
descriptions.dependencies: Needs ammunition. Needs to be reloaded after each shot. Needs maintenance.
descriptions.preservation_state: Poor. The pipe is rusting. The tape is peeling. The trigger is stiff.
descriptions.makeshift_utility: The pipe can be used as a tool. The tape can be used for repairs. The stock can be used as a club.
